{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_parsed'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99)
print(f"QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()} rows")

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print(f"Refunded orders found: {refunded_mask.sum()} rows")

# Filter: only completed orders, exclude QA and refunded
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                  (df['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99)]

# Check the grouping again
print("\nGrouped data by channel and customer_segment:")
grouped = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)
print(grouped)

# Explicitly check the paid_search returning row
paid_search_returning = grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'returning')]
print(f"\nPaid_search returning average revenue: {paid_search_returning}")

# Save for audit
grouped.to_csv('grouped_revenue_audit.csv')
print("\nAudit saved.")"}
